method unique_digits(x: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |x| > 0 // x must be a non-empty sequence of positive integers
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] >= 0 // result will contain non-negative integers
    ensures forall n :: n in result ==> 0 < n < 10^9 // Each element in result is a positive integer less than 10^9
    ensures result == [y | y <- x, isUniqueDigits(y) && not hasEvenDigit(y)] // result contains only numbers with unique odd digits
    ensures result == sorted(result) // result is sorted in increasing order
    
method isUniqueDigits(n: int) returns (b: bool)
    ensures b ==> (countUniqueDigits(n) == countDigits(n)) // If b is true, all digits in n are unique
    ensures !b ==> (countUniqueDigits(n) < countDigits(n)) // If b is false, not all digits in n are unique
    
method hasEvenDigit(n: int) returns (b: bool)
    ensures b ==> exists d :: d in digits(n) && d % 2 == 0 // If b is true, n contains at least one even digit
    ensures !b ==> forall d :: d in digits(n) ==> d % 2 != 0 // If b is false, all digits in n are odd
